# Simulacros TAI

> Web exam simulator for the Spanish TAI civil service examination (INAP): practice exams under the official marking scale, a study mode with immediate correction and performance analytics per syllabus block. The interface is in Spanish.

## Links

- [Application](https://tai.naindev.com/): the simulator; it also works offline from a bundled question catalogue
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/NainTAI): React and TypeScript client, ASP.NET Core API, requirements and architecture documents
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): the author's main site
